snippet.title: Gorgon's Garden - Trailer
snippet.description:
https://feverdreamjohnny.itch.io/gorgons-garden

On a summer day in 2008 you find yourself lurking on Hypogeum.net, a niche forum that used to be centered around an MMO known as "Gorgon's Garden," before the game became inaccessible due to the introduction of a paywall for a long-defunct digital currency.

However... The forum's resident hacker has successfully managed to crack said MMO, removing the paywall and allowing users to explore it all over again.

So you download the cracker and run it... 

And that's when the trouble starts.

---

Trailer music by Maple (https://soundcloud.com/careinq)
